app.title: Media Platform v{version}
brand.title: MEDIA PLATFORM
brand.subtitle: STUDIO MASTER v{version}
sidebar.toggle_theme_tip: Quickly cycle between visual presets (dark, slate blue, and light)
nav.capture_desc: Inspect media links or searches, select format/resolution, and configure sponsor detection.
nav.queue_desc: Monitor real-time download progress, manage priorities, and view sponsor cut logs.
nav.library_desc: Browse your indexed SQLite (WAL mode) history with SHA-256 cryptographic verification.
nav.ffmpeg_desc: Process local media: lossless remuxing, target-size compression, and LUFS loudness normalization.
nav.settings_desc: Configure UI language, naming templates, queue concurrency, bandwidth limits, proxy, cookies, and privacy.
nav.security_desc: Audit external engines, hot-swap yt-dlp with SHA-256 verification, and review the GPLv3 license.
nav.theme_desc: Customize the live ergonomic color palette, surface contrast, and border geometry.
mode.simple_tip: Streamlined interface for beginners: URL bar, preview, quality selector, and direct download
mode.advanced_tip: Full advanced interface: fragment threads, subtitles, SponsorBlock/AI, time trim, LUFS, and DVR
header.ffmpeg_missing: FFmpeg not found: required for merging 1080p+/4K video, extracting audio, and cutting sponsors. Install it system-wide or place it in portable_data/bin/.
